reviewer: main assistant only, unblinded, not formal independent native-human evaluation
full_output_success: Read the entire unmodified output with its prefix: natural Japanese grammar, coherent semantic continuation on the given topic, no unsupported topic replacement or harmful loop, and appropriate genuine EOS under the unchanged strict protocol. An initially plausible clause, ack, EOS alone or lower NLL is insufficient.
old24_baseline: PR102 conservative original-token boundary baseline2/24 retained; borderline case is not retrospectively promoted
new9: Nine source-family DEV cases newly exposed in this study; selection DEV, never renamed unseen TEST. References are not the only possible valid continuation.
repetition: Automatic repeated4gram is a proxy, harmful repetition is assessed on full text; purposeful ordinary repetition is not automatically failure.
selection: Frozen PLAN: full semantic success first, then repeated4gram count, then aggregate TF NLL; a numerical tie-break does not certify a more natural model.
generalization: Compare held-source-family outputs with fixed TRAIN probes and isolated overfit sequences. TRAIN reproduction is never unknown-family success.
formal_gate: Existing17/13/9, Pareto, daily-conversation repeat limits and formal R25 adoption remain unchanged; not asserted passed or fully rerun here. Research pretraining Go is separate from public replacement.
raw_evidence: JSON stores exact prefix/token sequence/rawBytesHex/strictUtf8/stop reason; no output repair or search/template completion; full-vocabulary greedy primary; no sealed TEST used. All33 prose prefixes checked as valid UTF8 before comparison completion.
index_convention: Repeated4gram indices are zero based; human token ordinal is index+1. First reference-token departure is not semantic-failure onset.
